# Log rotation
`bin/rotate <ログ dir> <退避先 dir> <名前> <日付>` はログを世代送りし（name.1, name.2, ...）、最新の世代を退避先に name.<日付> で写す。
ローカルの世代送りは lib/local.sh、退避先への写しは lib/archive.sh。

bin/rotate.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"
rotate_local "$1" "$3"
archive_copy "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4"

lib/local.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 n
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
}

`bin/ls-size <ファイル>...` はファイルの大きさを読みやすい形で出す（lib/size.sh の human_size）。

lib/size.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# human_size <bytes>: under 1024 -> "N B"; from 1024 -> KiB; from 1048576 (1024 KiB) -> MiB. One decimal place.
human_size() {
  local b=$1
  if [ "$b" -gt 1048576 ]; then
    awk -v b="$b" 'BEGIN { printf "%.1f MiB\n", b / 1048576 }'
  elif [ "$b" -gt 1024 ]; then
    awk -v b="$b" 'BEGIN { printf "%.1f KiB\n", b / 1024 }'
  else
    echo "$b B"
  fi
}

# Greenhouse
温室の制御スクリプト。
- `bin/vent <室内温度> <外気温>`: 天窓の開度（%）
- `bin/sensors`: センサーごとの最新値
- `bin/water-due <苗床> <今日の通算日>`: 最後に水をやってから苗床の間隔（日）が経っていれば `due`、まだなら `next in N days`
- `bin/sched <YYYY-MM-DD>`: その日の朝 5 時の自動散水で水をやる苗床
苗床の設定は data/beds.csv（苗床,最後に水をやった通算日,間隔の日数）。環境変数 BEDS で別のファイルを指せる。

bin/sched.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: sched <YYYY-MM-DD>. The beds the 05:00 irrigation run waters on that day.
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/dates.sh"
today=$(day_number "$1")
grep -v '^#' "${BEDS:-$root/data/beds.csv}" | cut -d, -f1 | while read -r bed; do
  [ "$(bash "$root/bin/water-due" "$bed" "$today")" = due ] && echo "water $bed"
done
exit 0

bin/vent.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: vent <inside C> <outside C>. Roof vent opening in percent.
in=$1; out=$2
if [ "$out" -lt 5 ]; then echo 0; exit 0; fi
if [ "$in" -le 18 ]; then echo 0
elif [ "$in" -ge 30 ]; then echo 100
else echo $(( (in - 18) * 100 / 12 )); fi

bin/water-due.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: water-due <bed> <today (day number)>
# "due" once the bed's interval has passed since it was last watered, else "next in N days".
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/dates.sh"
beds=${BEDS:-$root/data/beds.csv}
line=$(grep "^$1," "$beds") || { echo "unknown bed: $1" >&2; exit 1; }
last=$(echo "$line" | cut -d, -f2)
every=$(echo "$line" | cut -d, -f3)
d=$(days_since "$last" "$2")
if [ "$d" -ge "$every" ]; then echo due; else echo "next in $(( every - d )) days"; fi

#!/bin/bash
# Usage: build <lang>. Writes $BUILD/<lang>.txt (default build/) from $LOCALES/<lang>.txt (default locales/).
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
loc=${LOCALES:-$root/locales}; out=${BUILD:-$root/build}
mkdir -p "$out"
grep -v '^#' "$loc/$1.txt" | grep . > "$out/$1.txt"

bin/lint.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: lint <file>... Every non-comment line must be key=value with a non-empty key.
s=0
for f in "$@"; do
  n=0
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    n=$((n + 1))
    case $line in ''|'#'*) continue ;; esac
    case $line in [a-z]*=*) ;; *) echo "$f:$n: not key=value"; s=1 ;; esac
  done < "$f"
done
exit $s

# Usage: missing <lang>. The keys of en.txt that <lang>.txt lacks, one per line, then "missing: N".

loc=${LOCALES:-$root/locales}

#!/bin/bash
# Usage: sort-keys <file>. Rewrites the file with the comment header first and keys sorted.

# Log rotation
`bin/rotate <ログ dir> <退避先 dir> <名前> <日付>` はログを世代送りし（name.1, name.2, ...）、最新の世代を退避先に name.<日付> で写す。

bin/rotate.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"
keep=$(sed -n 's/^keep=//p' "$root/config/rotate.conf")
rotate_local "$1" "$3" "$keep"
archive_copy "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4"
archive_prune "$2" "$3" "$keep"

lib/local.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name> <keep>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 n i
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
  i=$((keep + 1))
  while [ -e "$dir/$name.$i" ]; do
    rm -f "$dir/$name.$i"
    i=$((i + 1))
  done
}

#!/bin/bash
# human_size <bytes>: under 1024 -> "N B"; from 1024 -> KiB; from 1048576 (1024 KiB) -> MiB. One decimal place.
human_size() {
  local b=$1
  if [ "$b" -ge 1048576 ]; then
    awk -v b="$b" 'BEGIN { printf "%.1f MiB\n", b / 1048576 }'
  elif [ "$b" -ge 1024 ]; then
    awk -v b="$b" 'BEGIN { printf "%.1f KiB\n", b / 1024 }'
  else
    echo "$b B"
  fi
}

- `bin/vent <室内温度> <外気温>`: 天窓の開度（%）

#!/bin/bash
# Usage: sched <YYYY-MM-DD>. The beds the 05:00 irrigation run waters on that day.
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/dates.sh"
today=$(day_number "$1")
grep -v '^#' "${BEDS:-$root/data/beds.csv}" | cut -d, -f1 | while read -r bed; do
  [ "$(bash "$root/bin/water-due" "$bed" "$today")" = due ] && echo "water $bed"
done
exit 0

bin/vent.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: vent <inside C> <outside C>. Roof vent opening in percent.
in=$1; out=$2
if [ "$out" -lt 5 ]; then echo 0; exit 0; fi
if [ "$in" -le 18 ]; then echo 0
elif [ "$in" -ge 30 ]; then echo 100
else echo $(( (in - 18) * 100 / 12 )); fi

bin/water-due.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: water-due <bed> <today (day number)>
# "due" once the bed's interval has passed since it was last watered, else "next in N days".
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/dates.sh"
beds=${BEDS:-$root/data/beds.csv}
line=$(grep "^$1," "$beds") || { echo "unknown bed: $1" >&2; exit 1; }
last=$(echo "$line" | cut -d, -f2)
every=$(echo "$line" | cut -d, -f3)
d=$(days_since "$last" "$2")
if [ "$d" -ge "$every" ]; then echo due; else echo "next in $(( every - d )) days"; fi

# Strings
画面の文言。locales/<言語>.txt に key=value で置き、`bin/build <言語>` で build/<言語>.txt を作る（アプリはこれを読む）。
環境変数 LOCALES / BUILD で入力と出力の場所を変えられる。

bin/build.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: build <lang>. Writes $BUILD/<lang>.txt (default build/) from $LOCALES/<lang>.txt (default locales/).
# Every key of en.txt, in en order, once; the translation when there is one, else the en value.
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/kv.sh"
loc=${LOCALES:-$root/locales}; out=${BUILD:-$root/build}
mkdir -p "$out"
: > "$out/$1.txt"
while IFS= read -r line; do
  case $line in ''|'#'*) continue ;; esac
  k=${line%%=*}
  v=$(kv_get "$loc/$1.txt" "$k") || v=${line#*=}
  printf '%s=%s\n' "$k" "$v" >> "$out/$1.txt"
done < "$loc/en.txt"
echo "built $out/$1.txt"

bin/lint.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: lint <file>... Every non-comment line must be key=value with a non-empty key.
s=0
for f in "$@"; do
  n=0
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    n=$((n + 1))
    case $line in ''|'#'*) continue ;; esac
    case $line in [a-z]*=*) ;; *) echo "$f:$n: not key=value"; s=1 ;; esac
  done < "$f"
done
exit $s

bin/missing.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: missing <lang>. The keys of en.txt that <lang>.txt lacks, one per line, then "missing: N".
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/kv.sh"
loc=${LOCALES:-$root/locales}
keys=$(comm -23 <(kv_keys "$loc/en.txt" | sort) <(kv_keys "$loc/$1.txt" | sort))
[ -n "$keys" ] && printf '%s\n' "$keys"
echo "missing: $(printf '%s' "$keys" | grep -c .)"

bin/sort-keys.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: sort-keys <file>. Rewrites the file with the comment header first and keys sorted.
f=$1
{ grep '^#' "$f"; grep -v '^#' "$f" | grep . | sort; } > "$f.tmp" && mv "$f.tmp" "$f"

README.md.text:
# Log rotation
`bin/rotate <ログ dir> <退避先 dir> <名前> <日付>` はログを世代送りし（name.1, name.2, ...）、最新の世代を退避先に name.<日付> で写す。
ローカルの世代送りは lib/local.sh、退避先への写しは lib/archive.sh。

bin/rotate.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"
keep=$(sed -n 's/^keep=//p' "$root/config/rotate.conf")
rotate_local "$1" "$3" "$keep"
archive_copy "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4"
archive_prune "$2" "$3" "$keep"

lib/local.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name> <keep>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 n i
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
  i=$((keep + 1))
  while [ -e "$dir/$name.$i" ]; do
    rm -f "$dir/$name.$i"
    i=$((i + 1))
  done
}

# Usage: book <room> <start HHMM> <end HHMM> <title>

lib/size.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# human_size <bytes>: under 1024 -> "N B"; from 1024 -> KiB; from 1048576 (1024 KiB) -> MiB. One decimal place.
human_size() {
  local b=$1
  if [ "$b" -gt 1048576 ]; then
    awk -v b="$b" 'BEGIN { printf "%.1f MiB\n", b / 1048576 }'
  elif [ "$b" -gt 1024 ]; then
    awk -v b="$b" 'BEGIN { printf "%.1f KiB\n", b / 1024 }'
  else
    echo "$b B"
  fi
}

# Greenhouse
温室の制御スクリプト。
- `bin/vent <室内温度> <外気温>`: 天窓の開度（%）
- `bin/sensors`: センサーごとの最新値
- `bin/water-due <苗床> <今日の通算日>`: 最後に水をやってから苗床の間隔（日）が経っていれば `due`、まだなら `next in N days`
- `bin/sched <YYYY-MM-DD>`: その日の朝 5 時の自動散水で水をやる苗床
苗床の設定は data/beds.csv（苗床,最後に水をやった通算日,間隔の日数）。環境変数 BEDS で別のファイルを指せる。

bin/sched.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: sched <YYYY-MM-DD>. The beds the 05:00 irrigation run waters on that day.
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/dates.sh"
today=$(day_number "$1")
grep -v '^#' "${BEDS:-$root/data/beds.csv}" | cut -d, -f1 | while read -r bed; do
  [ "$(bash "$root/bin/water-due" "$bed" "$today")" = due ] && echo "water $bed"
done
exit 0

bin/vent.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: vent <inside C> <outside C>. Roof vent opening in percent.
in=$1; out=$2
if [ "$out" -lt 5 ]; then echo 0; exit 0; fi
if [ "$in" -le 18 ]; then echo 0
elif [ "$in" -ge 30 ]; then echo 100
else echo $(( (in - 18) * 100 / 12 )); fi

bin/water-due.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: water-due <bed> <today (day number)>
# "due" once the bed's interval has passed since it was last watered, else "next in N days".
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/dates.sh"
beds=${BEDS:-$root/data/beds.csv}
line=$(grep "^$1," "$beds") || { echo "unknown bed: $1" >&2; exit 1; }
last=$(echo "$line" | cut -d, -f2)
every=$(echo "$line" | cut -d, -f3)
d=$(days_since "$last" "$2")
if [ "$d" -ge "$every" ]; then echo due; else echo "next in $(( every - d )) days"; fi

README.md.text:
# Strings
画面の文言。locales/<言語>.txt に key=value で置き、`bin/build <言語>` で build/<言語>.txt を作る（アプリはこれを読む）。
環境変数 LOCALES / BUILD で入力と出力の場所を変えられる。
`bin/lint` が書式を、`bin/sort-keys` が並びを整える。

bin/build.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: build <lang>. Writes $BUILD/<lang>.txt (default build/) from $LOCALES/<lang>.txt (default locales/).
# Every key of en.txt, in en order, once; the translation when there is one, else the en value.
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/kv.sh"
loc=${LOCALES:-$root/locales}; out=${BUILD:-$root/build}
mkdir -p "$out"
: > "$out/$1.txt"
while IFS= read -r line; do
  case $line in ''|'#'*) continue ;; esac
  k=${line%%=*}
  v=$(kv_get "$loc/$1.txt" "$k") || v=${line#*=}
  printf '%s=%s\n' "$k" "$v" >> "$out/$1.txt"
done < "$loc/en.txt"
echo "built $out/$1.txt"

bin/lint.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: lint <file>... Every non-comment line must be key=value with a non-empty key.
s=0
for f in "$@"; do
  n=0
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    n=$((n + 1))
    case $line in ''|'#'*) continue ;; esac
    case $line in [a-z]*=*) ;; *) echo "$f:$n: not key=value"; s=1 ;; esac
  done < "$f"
done
exit $s

bin/missing.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: missing <lang>. The keys of en.txt that <lang>.txt lacks, one per line, then "missing: N".
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/kv.sh"
loc=${LOCALES:-$root/locales}
comm -23 <(kv_keys "$loc/en.txt" | sort) <(kv_keys "$loc/$1.txt" | sort)
echo "missing: $(( $(kv_keys "$loc/en.txt" | wc -l) - $(kv_keys "$loc/$1.txt" | wc -l) ))"

bin/sort-keys.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: sort-keys <file>. Rewrites the file with the comment header first and keys sorted.
f=$1
{ grep '^#' "$f"; grep -v '^#' "$f" | grep . | sort; } > "$f.tmp" && mv "$f.tmp" "$f"

README.md.text:
# Lab equipment loans
実験室の機器の貸出記録。
- `bin/checkout <機器> <利用者> <今日 YYYY-MM-DD>`: 貸出を data/loans.tsv に追記する（環境変数 LOANS で別のファイル）
- `bin/return <機器>` / `bin/onloan`
機器の一覧は data/devices.tsv、校正記録は data/calibration.tsv（機器<TAB>校正期限日。環境変数 CALIB で別のファイル）。

bin/checkout.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: checkout <device> <user> <today YYYY-MM-DD>
# Appends device<TAB>user<TAB>date to $LOANS (default data/loans.tsv).
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
loans=${LOANS:-$root/data/loans.tsv}
. "$root/lib/calib.sh"
export CALIB=${CALIB:-$root/data/calibration.tsv}
if ! calib_ok "$1" "$3"; then
  echo "refused: $1 has no valid calibration on $3" >&2
  exit 1
fi
printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$1" "$2" "$3" >> "$loans"
echo "checked out $1 to $2"

bin/onloan.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: onloan. Devices currently on loan, by device id.

sort "${LOANS:-$root/data/loans.tsv}"

# Running log
練習の記録と計算。
- `bin/pace <km> <時間>`: 1 km あたりのペース。時間は m:ss か h:mm:ss。1 km あたりの秒数を整数に丸めて m:ss/km で出す（秒は 00〜59 の 2 桁）。例: `bin/pace 10 50:00` → `5:00/km`
- `bin/hr-zones <最大心拍>`: 心拍ゾーン
計算は lib/pace.sh（to_secs, pace）。アプリは pace の出力をそのまま表示する。

bin/hr-zones.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: hr-zones <max heart rate>. Zones 1-5 at 50/60/70/80/90 percent.
for z in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  echo "Z$z $(( $1 * (40 + z * 10) / 100 ))"
done
